candidates.rationale: The goods are described as 'LED light bulbs', which corresponds to the subheading for 'Light-emitting diode (LED) lamps' under heading 8539, as defined by Chapter 85 Note 11.
This subheading covers 'Light-emitting diode (LED) modules', which are distinct from the finished 'lamps' (bulbs) described in the invoice, making it an incorrect classification.
